subject: Private Deployment MAP Kickoff — Network, IAM, and Topology Owners
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Gupta <sana.gupta@acmehealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Private Deployment MAP Kickoff — Network, IAM, and Topology Owners

Hi Sana and Tom —

Thanks for taking the next step with Redwood for the private deployment evaluation. Per our conversation, we want to kick off a focused mutual action plan (MAP) to align owners, define the evaluation milestones, and lock on a close target. This thread will capture the core owners, immediate action items, and the recommended timeline.

Primary objectives for the MAP:
- Establish network connectivity approach (VPN vs. DirectConnect/ExpressRoute) and firewall/NAT requirements.
- Confirm IAM/KMS ownership and key access patterns for encrypted model artifacts and audit logs.
- Define topology for private control plane vs. on-prem inference nodes (VPC design, subnets, routing).
- Agree on evaluation criteria and go/no-go for production sign-off (latency, throughput, and security checklist).

Can you please confirm the two technical owners on your side for Networking and IAM/KMS? Also share any existing network diagrams or security constraints on the cloud side (VPC peering, egress restrictions, proxy requirements).

Proposed high-level timeline (we can adjust):
- Week 0 (this week): Owners and MAP template confirmed; initial network diagram shared.
- Week 1: Networking proof-of-connectivity (VPN tunnel + routing verification).
- Week 2: IAM/KMS key access test + data-in-transit and at-rest checks.
- Week 3: Baseline perf run (sample workload) and acceptance criteria review.

I attached a MAP template and a short networking checklist to centralize items. Suggested immediate next step: 30-minute sync tomorrow (May 11) at 10:00 AM PT to align owners and hit the ground running.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-map-template.xlsx, networking-checklist.pdf
From: Sana Gupta <sana.gupta@acmehealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T11:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Deployment MAP Kickoff — Network, IAM, and Topology Owners

Diego —

Appreciate the clear plan. Confirming owners from Acme Health:
- Networking: Tom Reynolds (Cloud Ops Manager) — tom.reynolds@acmehealth.com
- IAM/KMS: Priya Shah (Security Engineering) — priya.shah@acmehealth.com (cc'd after this reply)

Tom can share the current VPC diagram; we have a transit VPC and use AWS KMS with a customer-managed CMK that runs under an approvals workflow. A few constraints up front:
- No inbound public IPs allowed on inference nodes; we prefer private subnets with NAT for updates.
- All keys are in KMS; HSM is not in scope for this initial eval.

We're available for the 10:00 AM PT slot tomorrow. I'll loop Priya and any additional folks on the next email.

—Sana
Sana Gupta
VP Engineering, Acme Health
sana.gupta@acmehealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>, Sana Gupta <sana.gupta@acmehealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-11T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Deployment MAP Kickoff — Network, IAM, and Topology Owners

Thanks Diego / Sana —

On behalf of Redwood, here are the internal owners for this MAP: 
- Technical lead (deployment & topology): Marcus Lin, Solutions Engineering (marcus.lin@redwood.ai)
- Customer Success & acceptance criteria: Monica Patel, Customer Success (monica.patel@redwood.ai)
- Security & compliance / KMS liaison: Rachel Kim, Security (rachel.kim@redwood.ai)
- Network integration & ops: Neha Kapoor, Field Solutions (neha.kapoor@redwood.ai)

Suggested concrete milestone dates to make the evaluation time-boxed: 
- May 11 (EOD): Confirm owners + share network diagram (Acme) — owner: Tom / Sana
- May 14: Establish VPN tunnel and validate routes (connectivity smoke test) — owners: Tom + Neha
- May 18: KMS key ACLs and sample artifact decrypt test — owners: Priya (Acme) + Rachel (Redwood)
- May 21–22: Baseline performance run (10k tokens/min workload) + first pass latency report — owners: Marcus + Monica
- May 25: MAP review, sign-off go/no-go or adapt next steps — owners: Diego + Sana + Monica

A few technical notes for the sync tomorrow:
- If Acme prefers private NATed instances, we'll need a small egress allowlist for Redwood build/telemetry endpoints; we'll share a minimal list in advance.
- For KMS, if Acme's CMK policy requires a cross-account IAM role, we can provide a role ARN and a short runbook for temporary access during the eval.

I'll be on the 10:00 AM PT call and will bring the perf checklist and the MAP template.

-Marissa
Director, Solutions Origination, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Private Deployment MAP Kickoff — Network, IAM, and Topology Owners

Thanks everyone — great sync today. Confirming action items and owners (short list):
1) Tom (Acme) — Share current VPC diagram + security group ACLs by EOD May 11 (completed).
2) Neha (Redwood) + Tom — Establish VPN tunnel and validate route propagation by May 14.
3) Priya (Acme) + Rachel (Redwood) — Exchange KMS role details and run decrypt test by May 18.
4) Marcus (Redwood) + Monica (Acme/Redwood) — Run baseline perf test (small sample workload) May 21–22 and upload results to the shared Drive.
5) Diego + Sana + Monica — MAP review and go/no-go on May 25.

I attached the finalized MAP template and the networking checklist we went through. If any owner needs an addendum to the role (e.g., additional approvers on the CMK policy), highlight that in the shared doc this week so we can adjust.

Proposed close target: we aim to finish the evaluation and have a decision on a production timeline by May 31. If the perf and security criteria are met, we will prepare the Dedicated/Private onboarding SOW.

Thanks — I'll follow up with calendar invites and the Drive link for artifacts.

Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-map-template.xlsx, networking-checklist.pdf
